title.ja: 居酒屋で外国人のお客さんを接客
title.en: Serving foreign guests at an izakaya

summary.ja: 人数を聞いて、注文を受け、おすすめやお会計を英語で伝える。
summary.en: Seat the guests, take their order, recommend dishes and handle the bill.

setting: A busy izakaya in Tokyo on a Friday evening. A tourist comes in; the staff speak English to them.

roles.persona: A member of staff at the izakaya.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist from abroad, visiting with one friend (two people). Speak slowly and simply, and let the staff lead. Order two beers.

hints: 何名様か聞きましょう
How many …?
Hello! How many people?
飲み物を聞きましょう
What would you like to …?
What would you like to drink?
注文を確認しましょう
Two …, right?
Two beers, right?

levels.tutor: You are a tourist from abroad with one friend. Speak at natural pace. Ask what all-you-can-drink is, ask for a recommendation, and want to know when the last order is.

title.en: Ask how many, and table or counter

hints: 人数とテーブルかカウンターか聞きましょう
Would you like a table or …?
Would you like a table or the counter?
飲み放題の料金と時間を伝えましょう
All-you-can-drink is … for …
All-you-can-drink is 1,500 yen for 90 minutes.

title.ja: おすすめ料理を説明する

hints: おすすめ料理を説明しましょう
This is …. It's …
This is karaage. It's Japanese fried chicken.

title.ja: ラストオーダーを伝える

hints: ラストオーダーの時間を伝えましょう
Last order is at …
Last order is at 10:30.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist from abroad with a friend, speaking at natural speed with some small talk. Order food and drinks, and at the end ask to pay separately.

hints: 人数を聞いて席に案内しましょう
Right this way. Is … okay?
Right this way. Is the counter okay?

title.ja: おすすめ料理を説明する

hints: おすすめを説明しましょう
I'd recommend …. It's …
I'd recommend the yakitori. It's grilled chicken on skewers.

title.ja: 注文を受けて確認する

hints: 注文を確認しましょう
So that's …, right?
So that's two highballs and the yakitori, right?

title.en: Ask how they'd like to pay

hints: 別々か一緒か聞きましょう
Would you like to pay … or …?
Would you like to pay separately or together?

twist.tutor: Say you are allergic to shellfish, and ask whether the dish you're interested in is safe.

title.ja: アレルギーに対応する

hints: 確認すると伝えて、安心できる料理をすすめましょう
Let me check with … This one …
Let me check with the kitchen. This one has no shellfish.

levels.tutor: You are the izakaya staff member. Speak slowly and simply. Ask how many people, take the drink order, and bring the bill when asked.

hints: 人数を伝えましょう
…, please.
Two people, please.
飲み物を注文しましょう
Can we have …?
Can we have two beers?
お会計をお願いしましょう
Can we have the …?
Can we have the check, please?

levels.tutor: You are the izakaya staff member, speaking at natural pace. Explain all-you-can-drink if asked, recommend karaage, and mention last orders.

hints: 人数を伝えましょう
A table for …, please.
A table for two, please.

title.ja: 飲み放題について聞く

hints: 飲み放題について聞きましょう
How does … work?
How does all-you-can-drink work?
おすすめを聞きましょう
What do you …?
What do you recommend?
料理を注文しましょう
We'll have …
We'll have the karaage and edamame, please.

levels.tutor: You are the izakaya staff member, speaking at natural speed. Be helpful about the menu; when asked about allergies, say you'll check with the kitchen.

title.ja: 人数と席の希望を伝える
title.en: Say how many, and where you'd like to sit

hints: 人数と席の希望を伝えましょう
There are … of us. Could we …?
There are two of us. Could we sit at the counter?
アレルギーを伝えて確認しましょう
I'm allergic to … Is this …?
I'm allergic to shellfish. Is this okay for me?

title.ja: 料理と飲み物を注文する

hints: 注文しましょう
Could we get …?
Could we get two highballs and the yakitori?

title.ja: 別々に払いたいと伝える

hints: 別々に払いたいと伝えましょう
Could we pay …?
Could we pay separately, please?
